sections.title: About Gaoteng Energy
sections.text: 30 years of power electronics experience — from cells to complete systems.

sections.title: Engineering Reliable Energy for the World
sections.text:
Gaoteng Energy is a manufacturer of hybrid inverters, monocrystalline solar panels and LiFePO4 battery storage. From a single cell to a megawatt-scale project, we design systems that keep homes and businesses powered.

Our vertically integrated factory in China produces, tests and delivers to more than 20 countries across Africa, Asia and the Middle East.

cards.title: Founded
cards.text: Started as a power electronics workshop supplying inverters to local projects.

cards.title: Battery Division
cards.text: Launched LiFePO4 battery production with in-house BMS development.

cards.title: Global Export
cards.text: Expanded to 20+ countries with regional partners in Africa and Asia.
